infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: GRIDGO needs the phone's location to pin the delivery drop-off.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: GRIDGO uses your location only while the app is open, to pin the delivery drop-off. It never follows you in the background.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: GRIDGO uses your location only while the app is open, to pin the delivery drop-off. It never follows you in the background.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: GRIDGO does not turn on your camera. Calls with your rider are voice only, and pictures come from your photo library.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: GRIDGO does not read your motion or fitness activity. It only uses your location, while the app is open, to pin the drop-off.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: GRIDGO does not use Face ID. Your sign-in stays in the phone's secure storage.
